scope_policy: All 18 native children remain accepted. No reviewed exclusion has been inferred from absent implementation.
promotion_boundary: Candidate contracts authorize evidence-first implementation only. They do not establish installed execution, scientific approval, stable maturity, release, registry publication, issue closure or polyglot parity.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Deterministic one-way, two-way, scenario and threshold response surfaces with baseline, direction, tie and switch-point semantics; not PSA, EVPPI or global sensitivity.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Each input/output retains declared units; deterministic callbacks are conditioned on the frozen baseline and explicitly varied coordinates.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Expected gain from resolving uncertainty over a declared candidate distributional family or assumption, with model probabilities and conditional decisions; distinct from equity and parameter EVPPI.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Value uses declared utility/loss units and conditions first on model family under the frozen model-probability convention.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Versioned qualitative assessment, dissent and audit workflow that prioritizes information questions without inventing cardinal values, probabilities, utilities or currency.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Ordinal recommendation classes have no numerical units; source, confidence, missingness and human-review state are mandatory.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: VoF=V(flexible feasible policy set)-V(constrained commitment set) under matched information, horizon, discounting and costs; combined information and option value must be decomposed.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Both policy values share one declared value unit and information structure; sequential periods and mutually exclusive timing scenarios must not be conflated.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Expected decision value of perfectly resolving declared criterion-performance, preference or joint latent variables under a finite compensatory additive-value model, with baseline and conditional choices, complete ties, gross/net value, interaction, regret, rank acceptability and raw-criterion Pareto diagnostics.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Criteria retain declared raw units and directions; value functions and normalization anchors are fixed ex ante; nonnegative weights sum to one; the finite joint law preserves outcome/preference correlation; aggregate values use the declared common value unit.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Gross/net change in the declared expected-value, utility, CVaR, chance-constrained or minimax-regret objective between matched current and post-information feasible policy problems.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Risk functional, objective direction, constraint units, feasible set and cost placement are fixed across information states.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Signed ENBS=EVSI-cost across evaluated designs, exact COSS selection under a declared tie policy, and dimensionless EVSI/EVPI efficiency with zero-denominator and bounds handling.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: EVSI, EVPI and cost share population, horizon, discounting and value units; efficiency is dimensionless.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Expected decision-value gain from a declared probabilistic forecast or signal at a horizon/freshness/latency, net of cost; predictive accuracy alone is not value.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Value uses declared operational objective units and the joint forecast-outcome law, conditioned on horizon and information time.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Gross/net decision value of an optimized feasible bundle or sequence of dependent information sources, including conditional marginal value and attribution.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Sources share a declared joint observation model, decision value unit, timing, rights and cost basis; independent additive EVSI is insufficient.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Current, information, implementation and joint value matrix with explicit interaction and no default independence assumption.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Matched population, horizon, value units, uptake, chronology and cost placement; see the #314 classification checkpoint.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Direction-aware EEV, recourse/stochastic-program, wait-and-see, VSS and EVPI contrasts; EVIU requires a declared point-estimate comparator.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: EEV, RP, WS, VSS, EVPI and EVIU share the declared objective unit, population, horizon and discount basis; scenario conditioning, recourse, nonanticipativity and solver evidence are matched. See the #314 classification checkpoint.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: EUI, CEI, BPI and SPI under declared utility; VoC is the clairvoyant-policy presentation and reduces to monetary EVPI only under positive-affine utility.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Utility, wealth/reference state, payoff units, information structure and sure-transfer cost location are explicit.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Perfect/imperfect event information plus a declared density whose integral recovers the associated value within tolerance.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Matched value units, event/signal law, reference policy and integration measure; see the #314 classification checkpoint.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Net value of adaptive observation/control policies against a matched no-sensing or open-loop comparator over the declared belief process and horizon.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Matched reward, transition, observation, belief update, horizon, discount and sensing costs; see the #314 checkpoint.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Signed recipient, stakeholder and social-welfare changes under declared information allocation and disclosure policies, without global zero clipping.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Stakeholder utilities and welfare aggregation may be incomparable unless explicitly normalized; rights and baseline allocation are mandatory.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Static value of acting on known subgroup structure and dynamic value of research about subgroup effects, with subgroup EVPI/EVSI reported separately.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Population-average and subgroup policies share the declared value unit, population, horizon and discount basis. Static contrasts condition on currently known subgroup membership; dynamic contrasts additionally average over the declared subgroup-effect information action. Population weights, eligibility, feasibility, multiplicity and fairness are explicit.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: Outcome-conditional system-value shift and decision gain VSI_x, with E[VSI_x]=EVSI only under declared classical assumptions, plus dispersion and low-value probability.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: VSI_x, EVSI, delta, system-value shifts and any included cost share the declared value unit, population, horizon and discount basis. The predictive outcome law is fixed before conditioning on x and optimizing the posterior policy; cost placement and prospective/retrospective scope are explicit.

contracts.estimand_or_contract: EVPPI_var and EVSI_var reduce the declared target variance; vector targets require declared covariance outputs and a separately reviewed scalar functional.
contracts.units_and_conditioning: Scalar variance has squared target units; prior, likelihood, conditioning sigma-field, averaging and estimator convention are explicit.
